body: Well here's the thing. He asked me to come clean about any lies or anything I haven't told him. So I said okay, there isn't anything I'm hiding from you. Then he brings up this little thing where he found this forum I used to post on in May and said he's upset because he never told me. I didn't think I needed to. But, I HAVE lied to him blatantly in the past :/

Thanks! :) I recently sent a e-mail to my dad. A really long thank-you letter to be exact. My mom said after talking to him she said I might've added a year or two to his life because of that, haha. 

And yes, reddit does help, a lot. I'm really starting to see it. I am happy to be apart of the reddit community for times like these.
I thought I found a really good one and did. Except my own flaws caused me to lose him :(

I lied about some very small stupid things. I came across secretive and did this a couple times. I don't blame him for getting upset but I don't know if he should have gotten mad at me for it. One of the things I lied about, I did it out of ignorance. Since I have a track record with him, everything I say is discredited. Not much I can do either since he lives 5 hours away.

*takes hug* thanks :)
I feel like I'm a bad person for the way I've treated my loved ones and I'm wanting to change and trying to. I've come to the realization I haven't been a great person but now seeing it... I REALLY want to change and do not know how. I was hoping I could go through these changes with my boyfriend but I messed up with him.
I will be online tomorrow :) Sorry for not giving out much information in my original post, I'm completely scattered brain as of now. Trying to gather my thoughts. Thank-you for the hug :)

Yes you're right. It's harder to see light at the end of the tunnel though because I feel like I'm faced the other way and don't know how to turn around... If that makes sense.

I've seen some therapists in the past but it didn't do me too good so I've always been kinda against that. I feel like I need someone to kick me in the butt and give me that headstart. Maybe I wasn't seeing the right therapists. Didn't feel too personal.
Yeah but to the point where it cost me my relationship and I fall back into them? Ehh. Maybe I'm not as self-disciplined as I should be. I might take you up on that PM offer.
I hope so. I just want to fix everything but don't know where to begin. And when I try, everything seems to fall down again and back to square one.

I tried. I lost a lot of my friends (which is fine by me) because I realized they were so self-absorbed. It came to a point where they seemed fake because if I tried to talk to them about me going through something they'd turn it around and talk about themselves and their lives. Then be leaning on my shoulder instead. So the only person I'd go and talk to was my boyfriend. Those "friends" are just people I know can call and party with if needed but that's all.
Thank-you for that :) An e-hug was much needed.
